scope: Remote URL harvesting source references and failure reporting

behavior.source_reference: Harvest logs retain the validated source host/path while removing URL user-info, query parameters, and fragments.
behavior.failure_reporting: Unexpected HTTP/provider/parse failures persist and return only operation plus exception class; known local URL validation messages retain safe operator guidance.
behavior.request_behavior: The original URL is still used for the request after validation, redirects remain disabled, and existing success/error status and log IDs remain intact.

coverage: URL credentials and query/fragment secrets are absent from stored source references
provider exception details are absent from persisted and returned error messages
the request still receives the original URL and safe embedded-credential validation guidance remains

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake connection, mocked HTTP client, and validation-only input

limitations: No DNS resolution, external HTTP request, or database write was performed.
The retained URL path can contain source-specific identifiers; query data, fragments, and user-info are removed.
